usedFor: Help Scout holds support conversations, and TRIGGERcmd runs “Trigger Command” on your computers when one is assigned.

bestTemplate.name: “Conversation Assigned” in Help Scout, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: An assignment is a clear handoff, so a command on your computer can run at that moment.

watchOut: “Tags Updated” fires whenever conversation tags change, so “Trigger Command” may run often.
